xBRIEFInfo.author: overdeck/0.69.0
xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4540: Auto-merge records a gate refusal inside triggerMerge as a failed merge; approved green PRs are stranded forever at that head

plan.title: Auto-merge records a gate refusal inside triggerMerge as a failed merge; approved green PRs are stranded forever at that head
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: A merge-gate refusal inside triggerMerge, raised before any merge ran, was recorded as a failed auto-merge row, which is never re-armed at the same head; a transient mergeable:null read was also reported as a missing approval.
narratives.Proposal: Return gate refusals from triggerMerge as refused and mark the row blocked so the scheduler re-arms it; report checks and mergeability before an unproven approval; re-read an unknown mergeability once after 3 s, bypassing the PR-facts cache.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No change to the #3983 rule that a failed row stays failed at its head
- No retry loop beyond one mergeability re-read
- No new HTTP route, CLI verb or setting

items.title: Mark a row blocked, not failed, when the gate inside triggerMerge refuses

expected_outputs: npx vitest run src/dashboard/server/services/__tests__/auto-merge-executor.test.ts src/dashboard/server/services/__tests__/auto-merge-scheduler.test.ts src/dashboard/server/routes/workspaces/__tests__/merge-ops-server-rebase.test.ts completes without errors

narrative.Action: triggerMerge returns refused: true for a gate refusal; the executor calls markMergeRefused (status blocked) and the scheduler re-arms the blocked row.

items.title: Given the executor's gate passes but triggerMerge's gate refuses, when the executor handles the result, then the row ends blocked, not failed
Given a row blocked by such a refusal, when the gate passes again at the same head, then the scheduler re-arms it
Given failing required checks or a CONFLICTING PR at the pre-merge PR-state check, when triggerMerge returns, then the result carries refused true and no merge command ran
Report checks and mergeability before an unproven approval

expected_outputs: npx vitest run src/lib/cloister/__tests__/pr-facts-readiness-order.test.ts completes without errors

narrative.Action: evaluateMergeReadiness raises the GitHub approval-at-head refusal only for a green, mergeable PR. The GitLab MR interfaces move to gitlab-mr-types.ts (re-exported) to keep pr-facts.ts under the file-size ceiling.

items.title: Given an approving review at head, green checks and mergeable null, when evaluateMergeReadiness runs, then it returns a mergeability reason, not not approved at PR HEAD
Given red checks and no proven approval, when evaluateMergeReadiness runs, then it reports the checks
Re-read an unknown mergeability once before deciding

expected_outputs: npx vitest run src/lib/cloister/__tests__/merge-gate.test.ts completes without errors

narrative.Action: evaluateIssueMergeGate waits MERGEABILITY_REREAD_MS and re-reads fresh PR facts once when an open, green PR has mergeable null.

items.title: Given mergeable is null on the first read and true on the re-read, when the gate runs under fake timers, then the gate passes
Given mergeable is still null on the re-read, when the gate runs, then it reports mergeability, not a missing approval
Document failed vs blocked auto-merge rows

expected_outputs: npm run lint:docs completes without errors

narrative.Action: Add the Auto-merge rows failed vs blocked section and update the auto-merge configuration page.

items.title: Given docs/MERGE-WORKFLOW.md, when the auto-merge rows section is read, then it states that failed means a merge ran and blocked means it was refused and re-arms
Given configuration/auto-merge.mdx, when the failure handling text is read, then it matches the failed vs blocked rule and the mergeability re-read
